 Print ‘ Ramayana : Rise Of A Legend’ has had a remarkable first week at the box office and the film is on a winning streak, on its way to break several records. The film achieved a series of milestones within its first seven days, including the biggest-ever Monday collection for a Hindi film, followed by record performances on Tuesday and Wednesday. As per Sacnilk, the film concluded its first week on Thursday, November 12, with an India collection of Rs 564 crore. Its impressive run continued on the eighth day, when it earned Rs 53.50 crore, followed by Rs 48 crore on Friday. The film witnessed a significant jump on its second Saturday, collecting Rs 72.90 crore. With the second weekend in progress, the numbers are expected to rise further as evening and night shows contribute to the overall collection. The film has already collected Rs 31.40 crore net through advance bookings for Sunday, day 11 putting it ahead of the entire day 11 collection of 'Dhurandhar' even before spot bookings and walk-ins are taken into account. This puts the second Sunday records of 'Jawan', 'Stree 2' and 'Dhurandhar 2' under considerable pressure. With 11.49 lakh tickets sold at an average ticket price of Rs 326, ' Join conversation

 Ramayana ' has already secured Rs 31.40 crore net before the first show. It now needs approximately Rs 31.61 crore from spot bookings and walk-ins through the day to surpass 'Dhurandhar 2's second Sunday record of Rs 63 crore. As of now, till afternoon, on day 11, which is its second Sunday, 'Ramayana' has collected Rs 75 crore till evening. The total collection of the film stands at Rs 760 crore in India. At the worldwide box office, the film has made Rs 1228 crore. Day wise collection of 'Ramayana: Part 1'
